LEGAL NOTICE

From: R. K. Iyer, Advocate, 12 Court Road, Bengaluru

To: Mr. Arjun Das, 45 Park Street, Kolkata

Date: 10 September 2026

Under instructions from my client, Sunrise Traders, I hereby serve you with this legal notice.

1. My client supplied goods to you under invoice number ST-2291 dated 5 May 2026 for Rs. 2,40,000.

2. Despite repeated reminders, you have failed to pay the invoice amount, which was due on 4 June 2026.

3. You are hereby called upon to pay the sum of Rs. 2,40,000 together with interest at 18% per annum within fifteen (15) days of receipt of this notice.

4. Failing which, my client will be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you, at your risk as to costs and consequences.
